title: Bone Healing and Fracture Rehab — What Bone Needs, Week by Week

hook.en: After a fracture, patients ask: "When can I put weight on it? When can I use it again?" The answer depends on how bone heals, how the fracture was fixed and what the surgeon allows. Learn the stages of bone healing, what speeds or slows it, and how to rehab safely around a healing fracture.
hook.ur: Fracture ke baad mareez poochte hain: "Kab wazan daal sakta hoon? Kab dobara istemal kar sakta hoon?" Jawab is par munhasir hai ke haddi kaise judti hai, fracture kaise fix hua aur surgeon kya ijazat deta hai. Haddi judne ke marahil, isay tez ya aahista karne wali cheezen, aur judti fracture ke saath mehfooz rehab seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll describe the stages of bone healing and their timescale, explain weight-bearing instructions, list factors that delay healing, keep nearby joints and muscles moving during immobilisation, and recognise complications such as compartment syndrome, clots and non-union.
goal.ur: End tak aap haddi judne ke marahil aur un ka waqt bayan karenge, wazan daalne ki hidayaat samjhayenge, judne mein der karne wale asbaab ginayenge, band karne ke dauran qareebi joints aur muscles ko harkat mein rakhenge, aur compartment syndrome, clot aur non-union jaisi paicheedgiyan pehchanenge.

text.en: Bone heals in overlapping stages: **inflammation** (first days: a blood clot forms at the fracture), **soft callus** (about 2 to 3 weeks: fibrous tissue and cartilage bridge the gap), **hard callus** (about 3 to 12 weeks: the callus turns to woven bone and the fracture becomes clinically united) and **remodelling** (months to years: bone reshapes along the lines of load). Healing time varies: a child's wrist may unite in 3 to 4 weeks, an adult's tibia may take 3 to 6 months. **Load helps bone** once it is stable enough — but the **weight-bearing instruction from the surgeon** sets the limit.
text.ur: Haddi aapas mein milte julte marahil mein judti hai: **sozish** (pehle din: fracture par khoon ka lothra banta hai), **narm callus** (takreeban 2 se 3 hafte: resha daar tissue aur cartilage khala par pul banate hain), **sakht callus** (takreeban 3 se 12 hafte: callus woven bone mein badalta hai aur fracture clinically jur jata hai) aur **remodelling** (mahine se saal: haddi load ki lakeeron ke mutabiq shakal badalti hai). Judne ka waqt mukhtalif hai: bachay ki kalai 3 se 4 hafte mein jur sakti hai, baaligh ki tibia 3 se 6 mahine le sakti hai. Jab kaafi mustahkam ho to **load haddi ki madad karta hai** — magar **surgeon ki wazan daalne ki hidayat** hadd tay karti hai.

text.en: A healing fracture is like **a road being repaired**: first the hole is filled with gravel (soft callus), then tarmac is laid (hard callus), and over the following months traffic presses it smooth (remodelling). Driving heavy trucks over wet tarmac ruins it, but no traffic at all leaves it weak.
text.ur: Judti fracture **marammat hoti sarak** jaisi hai: pehle gaddha bajri se bhara jata hai (narm callus), phir tarcol bichaya jata hai (sakht callus), aur aane wale mahinon mein traffic isay hamwaar karta hai (remodelling). Geele tarcol par bhaari truck chalana isay barbaad karta hai, magar bilkul traffic na ho to kamzor reh jata hai.

steps.title: Read the instructions
steps.detail: Check the fracture type, how it was treated (cast, plate, nail, frame) and the weight-bearing status: non-weight-bearing, touch-weight-bearing, partial, or weight-bearing as tolerated. || Hidayaat parhein

steps.title: Move everything else
steps.detail: While the fracture is immobilised, keep the joints above and below moving (where allowed), exercise the other limbs, and do isometric exercises for muscles under the cast to limit wasting. || Baqi sab harkat mein rakhein

steps.title: Teach safe walking
steps.detail: Teach crutch or frame walking at the permitted weight-bearing level, including stairs, and check that the patient can follow the limit (for example using bathroom scales to feel partial weight). || Mehfooz chalna sikhayein

steps.title: Restore after union
steps.detail: Once the surgeon confirms healing, regain range, strength, balance and function progressively, then return to work or sport. Stiffness and weakness, not the bone, are often the slowest to recover. || Judne ke baad bahal karein

question.en: At about which stage does a fracture usually become clinically united?
question.ur: Fracture aam taur par kis marhale par clinically jur jati hai?

feedback.en: Remodelling continues after union, not before.
feedback.ur: Remodelling judne ke baad jaari rehti hai, pehle nahi.

feedback.en: The fracture is least stable then.
feedback.ur: Us waqt fracture sab se kam mustahkam hoti hai.

text.en: Hard callus, about 3 to 12 weeks depending on the bone
text.ur: Sakht callus, haddi ke mutabiq takreeban 3 se 12 hafte

feedback.en: Yes — woven bone bridges the gap and the fracture is stable.
feedback.ur: Haan — woven bone khala par pul banati hai aur fracture mustahkam hoti hai.

rows.en: No weight through the leg at all
Hop with crutches or frame, foot off the floor
rows.ur: Baisakhiyon ya frame se koodein, paon zameen se ooper

rows.en: Foot rests on the floor for balance only
rows.ur: Paon sirf balance ke liye zameen par

A set amount, for example 20 kg or 50 percent
rows.ur: Tay miqdar, maslan 20 kg ya 50 percent

rows.en: Use aids until walking is normal
rows.ur: Normal chalne tak sahare istemal karein

text.en: **Know the fix, know the load, move the rest.** Understand how the fracture was treated, follow the weight-bearing order exactly, and keep everything else moving.
text.ur: **Fix jaanein, load jaanein, baqi ko harkat dein.** Samjhein fracture ka ilaj kaise hua, wazan daalne ki hidayat bilkul follow karein, aur baqi sab ko harkat mein rakhein.

text.en: **Ignoring the joints next to the cast.** Shoulders stiffen after wrist fractures and fingers stiffen under swelling when they are not moved. Teach finger, elbow and shoulder exercises from day one after a wrist fracture, and the same for toes, knee and hip with lower-limb casts.
text.ur: **Cast ke saath wale joints ko nazarandaz karna.** Kalai ki fracture ke baad kandhe akar jate hain aur harkat na ho to sujan mein ungliyan akar jati hain. Kalai ki fracture ke baad pehle din se ungli, kohni aur kandhe ki exercises sikhayein, aur taang ke cast mein panjon, ghutne aur hip ke liye bhi yehi.

question.en: Which factor most clearly slows bone healing?
question.ur: Kaun si cheez haddi judne ko sab se wazeh taur par aahista karti hai?

feedback.ur: Yeh akrapan rokne mein madad karta hai.
Bachay baalighon se tez theek hote hain.

feedback.en: Yes — smoking reduces blood supply and is linked to delayed union and non-union.
feedback.ur: Haan — cigarette noshi khoon ki supply kam karti hai aur der se judne aur na judne se mutalliq hai.

question.en: A patient in a new below-knee cast has rapidly increasing pain not eased by painkillers, worse when the toes are moved. What is the concern?
question.ur: Naye ghutne se neeche cast mein mareez ka dard tezi se barh raha hai jo dard ki dawai se kam nahi hota, panje hilane par zyada. Kis baat ki fikr hai?

text.en: Compartment syndrome — an emergency needing immediate medical review
text.ur: Compartment syndrome — emergency jis ke liye fori medical jaanch chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — pain out of proportion and pain on passive stretch are key early signs.
feedback.ur: Haan — had se zyada dard aur passive stretch par dard ahem shuruati alamaat hain.

feedback.en: Increasing pain not eased by painkillers is not normal.
feedback.ur: Dard ki dawai se kam na hone wala barhta dard normal nahi.

text.en: A sign the cast is too loose
text.ur: Cast ke bohat dheela hone ki alamat

feedback.en: The danger is pressure, not looseness.
feedback.ur: Khatra dabao ka hai, dheelapan ka nahi.

text.en: **Talk about bone health.** A low-energy fracture (for example a wrist fracture from a fall from standing height in someone over 50) can be the first sign of osteoporosis. Suggest a bone-health assessment with the doctor, and include strength, balance and falls prevention in the rehab plan.
text.ur: **Haddiyon ki sehat ki baat karein.** Kam zor wali fracture (maslan 50 saal se zyada umar ke shakhs mein khare hone ki oonchai se girne par kalai ki fracture) osteoporosis ki pehli alamat ho sakti hai. Doctor ke saath haddiyon ki sehat ki jaanch ka mashwara dein, aur rehab plan mein taqat, balance aur girne se bachao shamil karein.

question.en: What are delayed union and non-union?
question.ur: Delayed union aur non-union kya hain?

answer.en: Delayed union means the fracture is taking longer than expected to heal; non-union means healing has stopped without bridging, often after about 6 to 9 months, with ongoing pain and movement at the fracture site. Risk factors include smoking, diabetes, poor blood supply, infection, too much movement at an unstable fracture, and some medicines. The surgeon may need to change the fixation or graft the bone.
answer.ur: Delayed union ka matlab hai fracture tawaqqo se zyada waqt le rahi hai; non-union ka matlab hai pul bane baghair judna ruk gaya, aksar takreeban 6 se 9 mahine baad, fracture ki jagah musalsal dard aur harkat ke saath. Khatre ki wajah mein cigarette noshi, diabetes, kamzor khoon ki supply, infection, ghair mustahkam fracture par zyada harkat, aur kuch dawaiyan shamil hain. Surgeon ko fixation badalni ya haddi ka graft karna par sakta hai.

beats.patient: A 67-year-old woman fell on her outstretched hand and had a distal radius fracture treated in a cast for 6 weeks. When the cast is removed, her wrist is stiff, her fingers are swollen and her shoulder is painful to lift. She has never had a bone-density scan.
beats.assessment: The fracture has united, but she has secondary stiffness from immobilisation and possible osteoporosis.
beats.treatment: Progressive wrist and finger range and strength, shoulder exercises, swelling control and functional tasks; suggest a bone-health assessment and include balance and falls prevention.
beats.reassess: After 10 weeks she has nearly full wrist movement, a pain-free shoulder and grip close to the other side, and has started osteoporosis treatment.

text.en: **Seek immediate medical help** for severe or increasing pain in a cast not relieved by medicine, pain on moving the fingers or toes, numbness, pale or blue fingers or toes (compartment syndrome or circulation problems), a hot, swollen calf or breathlessness (clot), or wound redness, discharge or fever (infection). **Never exceed the weight-bearing instruction** without the surgeon's agreement.
text.ur: **Fori medical madad lein** cast mein shadeed ya barhte dard jo dawai se kam na ho, ungliyon ya panjon ko hilane par dard, sunn-pan, peeli ya neeli ungliyon ya panjon (compartment syndrome ya circulation ke masail), garam, soojhi pindli ya saans phoolne (clot), ya zakhm mein surkhi, pani ya bukhar (infection) par. Surgeon ki ijazat ke baghair **wazan daalne ki hidayat se kabhi aage na jayein**.

summary.en: Bone heals through inflammation, soft callus, hard callus (clinical union around 3 to 12 weeks) and remodelling over months to years.
summary.ur: Haddi sozish, narm callus, sakht callus (takreeban 3 se 12 hafte par clinical judna) aur mahinon se saalon ki remodelling ke zariye judti hai.

summary.en: Follow the surgeon's weight-bearing instruction exactly, keep nearby joints and other limbs moving, and restore range, strength and function after union.
summary.ur: Surgeon ki wazan daalne ki hidayat bilkul follow karein, qareebi joints aur doosre aazaa ko harkat mein rakhein, aur judne ke baad range, taqat aur function bahal karein.

summary.en: Smoking and diabetes slow healing; compartment syndrome, clots and infection need urgent action, and low-energy fractures deserve a bone-health check.
summary.ur: Cigarette noshi aur diabetes judna aahista karte hain; compartment syndrome, clot aur infection ko fori qadam chahiye, aur kam zor wali fractures haddiyon ki sehat ki jaanch maangti hain.

back.en: Inflammation, soft callus, hard callus, remodelling.
back.ur: Sozish, narm callus, sakht callus, remodelling.

back.en: The foot rests on the floor for balance only, as if on an egg.
back.ur: Paon sirf balance ke liye zameen par, jaise ande par.

back.en: Pain out of proportion, not eased by medicine, worse on passive stretch of the fingers or toes.
back.ur: Had se zyada dard, dawai se kam na ho, ungliyon ya panjon ke passive stretch par zyada.

back.en: Healing has stopped without bridging the fracture, often after 6 to 9 months.
back.ur: Fracture par pul bane baghair judna ruk gaya, aksar 6 se 9 mahine baad.
